agent.finish_summary: Fixed IndexError regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py: ReindentFilter._get_offset used raw.splitlines()[-2] which raised IndexError when the flattened text up to a token contained only a single line (common case, e.g. 'select (1)', function calls, case expressions, identifier lists, VALUES clauses). Changed index from [-2] to [-1] so it correctly references the current line regardless of whether a prior newline exists. Verified fix resolves all reproduced failures (parenthesis, identifier list with subquery, function args, case expression, order by list, values clause, dotted identifiers) while preserving previously-working behavior (where clause, bare parenthesis, simple select).
